stories.headline: Anthropic Drops Claude Fable at 2x Opus Pricing — AI Race Accelerates
stories.thesis: Anthropic released Claude Fable today — earlier than any analyst expected, at 2x Opus pricing. Premium enterprise AI pricing is here. OpenAI filed S-1 same week.

stories.headline: SpaceX IPO 2 Days Out — $1.8T Valuation on 91% Loss Margin
stories.thesis: SpaceX lists June 12 at $1.8T+ valuation, raising $80B+. Q1 loss of $4.28B on $4.69B revenue — 96x revenue. OpenAI S-1 filed alongside. Defining capital markets moment of 2026.

stories.headline: Strategy Resumes Bitcoin Buying at $58K — Halts Panic, Shorts Squeezed
stories.thesis: MicroStrategy resumed BTC accumulation at $58K support — the world's largest corporate BTC holder halted the sell-off. Shorts targeting MSTR face capitulation risk.

stories.headline: South Korea Commits $350B to US — Protection Payment for Tariff Relief
stories.thesis: South Korea approved $350B (~20% GDP) in US strategic investments. $200B in strategic industries, $150B shipbuilding. Template for allies: pay or face tariffs.

stories.headline: Europe Ditches American Tech — 'Nobody Has a Kill Switch'
stories.thesis: EU unveils tech sovereignty package with explicit motive: eliminate US control over chip/cloud supply chains. $34B defense/tech inflow projected. ASML chief warns against directing supplies.
